name: Gymnast
l1: Passive: Vault may move through 1 adjacent allied character during movement.
l2: +1 MOVE and Vault may pass through any one occupied tile during movement. After Vaulting, this character may move 1 extra tile.
l3: Aurora Acrobat: +1 ATK and +1 MOVE. Once each turn after Vaulting, may make a 1-damage adjacent attack without spending AP.
role: Agile tester piece for movement tricks, Spirit Ember runs, and sudden pressure.

name: White Siberian Tiger
l1: Activated Pounce: Only while not mounted. Mark its next attack after moving as +2 ATK. Movement and attack costs still apply.
l2: +1 HP and +1 MOVE. Pounce also pushes the target 1 tile if possible.
l3: Aurora Predator: +1 ATK. When Pounce defeats a target, this character may move up to 2 tiles and refresh 1 character AP once per turn.
role: Fast pressure piece. Can carry an allied Hero or Leader, but Pounce is only available while not mounted.

name: Sniper
l1: Passive: Aim gives this character's basic attack +1 RANGE if it did not move this turn.
l2: +1 RANGE. Piercing Shot ignores 1 shield or damage reduction, and may ignore one occupied allied tile for line-of-sight.
l3: Dead Lane: +1 ATK. Once per turn, after damaging an enemy at range 3 or farther, mark that enemy; the next allied attack against it deals +1 damage.

name: Army General
l1: AP Ability: Command chooses an allied character within 2 tiles. That ally gains +1 ATK on its next attack this turn or may move 1 tile without spending an action.
l2: Command range becomes 3 and may target 2 allies. Each target chooses +1 ATK on its next attack or 1 free tile of movement.
l3: Tactical Mastery: +1 HP. Once per turn when a Commanded ally defeats an enemy or delivers a Spirit Ember, refresh 1 character AP on an allied character within 2 tiles.
role: Support commander. Unique: only 1 Leader. May mount an allied Mount.

name: Bogatyr Champion
l1: Passive: Stand Firm gives +1 maximum and current HP while this character is on or adjacent to the center tile.
l2: Heroic Guard: +2 maximum and current HP while on or adjacent to the center tile. Adjacent allies take -1 damage from attacks.
l3: Last Oath: +1 ATK and +2 maximum HP. The first time this character would be defeated, it remains at 2 HP and adjacent enemies take 1 damage.
role: Protect this piece. Unique: only 1 Hero. Enemy wins if captured. May mount an allied Mount.

name: Winter Engineer
l1: AP Ability: Barricade creates 1 barricade on an adjacent empty tile, or repairs an adjacent barricade or placed object by 1 HP. Barricades block movement and have 2 HP.
l2: Fortified Works: Barricades have 3 HP. When using Barricade, create or repair up to 2 adjacent barricades or placed objects.
l3: Frozen Redoubt: +1 HP. Once per turn, place a barricade or frost tile within 2 tiles. Allies adjacent to placed objects take -1 damage from ranged attacks.

name: Frost Seer
l1: AP Ability: Chill deals 1 damage at range 3. Target's MOVE is reduced by 1 and it cannot mount or dismount on its next turn.
l2: Winter Veil: Chill also gives one ally within 3 tiles a 1-damage shield. Shielded allies cannot be pushed this turn.
l3: Deep Freeze: +1 RANGE. Chill also prevents the target from using reaction or bonus movement effects next turn; if the target already has a slow marker, it cannot move next turn.

name: Quartz Attendant
l1: Passive: Synchronize gives +1 ATK while adjacent to another Atlantean.
l2: Shared Pulse: +1 HP. While adjacent to another Atlantean, gains +1 ATK and the first damage to one adjacent Atlantean each turn is reduced by 1.
l3: Collective Node: +1 HP. Counts as a pylon and as adjacent to Atlanteans within 2 tiles for Synchronize and relay effects.
role: Hive-mind common that rewards formation play.

name: Manta Glider
l1: Passive: Glide may move over occupied tiles but must end on an empty tile. If carrying a Hero or Leader, the mounted pair may also glide.
l2: +1 MOVE. After moving over any character, this character's next attack this turn gains +1 ATK.
l3: Phase Current: +1 HP and +1 ATK. Once per turn, ignore terrain, barricades, and occupied tiles during movement; deal 1 damage to one enemy moved over.
role: Mobile flanker and edge-run threat. Can carry an allied Hero or Leader.

name: Resonance Guard
l1: Passive: Quartz Armor reduces ranged attack damage by 1.
l2: Redirect: +1 ATK. Once per turn, may take damage for an adjacent ally; reduce that redirected damage by 1.
l3: Resonant Bastion: Adjacent allies gain a 1-damage shield at the start of your turn. After this character reduces damage, deal 1 damage back if the attacker is within range 2.

name: Divine Conductor
l1: AP Ability: Link Mind chooses an ally within 3 tiles. Until end of turn, that ally may use the Conductor's RANGE for its ability if valid, and may ignore one allied character for line-of-sight.
l2: Link Mind may target 2 allies within 3 tiles. Linked allies may use the Conductor's RANGE and ignore one allied character for line-of-sight.
l3: Perfect Chord: +1 RANGE. Once per turn, when a linked ally defeats an enemy or delivers a Spirit Ember, refresh that ally's character AP.
role: Hive-mind coordinator. Unique: only 1 Leader. May mount an allied Mount.

name: Oracle Sovereign
l1: AP Ability: Foresight reveals the next shared relic/event card. You may place it on the bottom of the deck. Then give one adjacent ally a 1-damage shield.
l2: Spirit Mantle: At the start of your turn, this character and one adjacent ally each gain a 1-damage shield. Foresight may instead leave the revealed card on top.
l3: Collective Ascension: +1 HP and +1 RANGE. Once per match, all allies heal 2, gain a 1-damage shield, and gain +1 MOVE this turn.
role: Protect this piece. Unique: only 1 Hero. Enemy wins if captured. May mount an allied Mount.

name: Crystal Architect
l1: AP Ability: Pylon places a quartz pylon on an adjacent empty tile, or moves an existing allied pylon 1 tile. Allies within 2 tiles of a pylon gain +1 RANGE on abilities.
l2: Pylon range becomes 2. Pylons have 2 HP, and allies within 2 tiles of a pylon gain +1 RANGE on attacks and abilities.
l3: Relay Gate: +1 HP. Once per turn, teleport an ally adjacent to a pylon to an empty tile adjacent to another pylon within 4 tiles, then give that ally a 1-damage shield.

name: Astral Harmonic
l1: AP Ability: Resonance Shield shields an ally within 3 tiles for 1 damage prevention. If that ally is mounted, the shield prevents 2 damage instead.
l2: Harmonic Bind: Resonance Shield prevents 2 damage and the shielded ally cannot be pushed, pulled, or displaced this turn.
l3: Astral Echo: +1 RANGE. After shielding an ally, may deal 1 damage to an enemy within 2 tiles of that ally; the shielded ally may move 1 tile without spending AP.
